Getting started with Reve
Reve is built on a simple idea: your creative vision comes first. We handle the complexity so you can focus on what you want to create.
Our models are trained from the ground up by our in-house research team and are best-in-class at aesthetics, text rendering and detail preservation. You can generate and edit images through conversation, make precise adjustments with the drag-and-drop editor, create video and even integrate Reve into your own tools via the API.
But let's start with the basics! In this section you'll learn how to navigate Reve, create images and video and begin to get the most out of the product.
Navigating Reve: Get familiar with the basics and find your way around the Reve workspace.
Creating images on Reve: Learn how to generate images through chat, use custom instructions, adjust aspect ratios, attach references and other fundamentals.
Creating video on Reve: Explore video creation using prompts or your images as reference frames, powered by our integration with Veo.
Reve API: An overview of Reve's API and where to learn more.
